title: Single-molecule analysis of gap and nick binding by LIG1 and LIG3α at the final step of DNA repair
authors: Surajit Chatterjee; Kar Men Lee; Kanal Balu; Melike Çağlayan
one_liner_zh: 该文用单分子荧光研究DNA连接酶与缺口/间隙DNA的结合动力学，属蛋白质-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅实验观测。
abstract: DNA ligase (LIG) 1 and LIG3α repair broken single-strand breaks in the phosphodiester backbone at the final ligation step of DNA excision repair pathways, and complement each other during nuclear replication in case of unligated Okazaki fragments. We previously reported that both ligases discriminate against nicks containing non-canonical ends and ligate gap intermediate if left unfilled by DNA polymerases. However, it remains unknown how the dynamics of DNA binding differ for gap versus nick substrates by LIG1 and LIG3α at single-molecule level. Here, using total internal reflection fluorescence (TIRF) and ligation assays, we showed that LIG3α binds less frequently but forms longer-lived complex than LIG1 for nicks containing canonical A:T, mismatch G:T, and damaged 8oxoG:A, and they exhibit subtle differences in discriminating unusual ends. Moreover, our results identified gap DNA as a new target to which LIG1 and LIG3α can bind as efficient as their preferential nick sites. We showed gap ligation and observed that more percentage of LIG1 molecules form stable long-lived complex on DNA containing one nucleotide gap, whereas LIG3α forms short-lived gap complex without any differences in the percentage of molecule forming gap-bound complex. Finally, our findings demonstrated that LIG1 can still stably bind to larger gaps with better recognition, whereas LIG3α binding becomes further infrequent and shorter-lived. Overall, our study provides single-molecule insights into intricate differences between LIG1 and LIG3α for binding to a range of mutagenic and deleterious DNA repair and replication intermediates that could be a threat for maintaining genome stability at the final step.
abstract_zh: DNA连接酶（LIG）1和LIG3α在DNA切除修复途径的最后连接步骤中修复磷酸二酯骨架上的单链断裂，并在核复制过程中，当冈崎片段未连接时相互补充。我们此前报道过，这两种连接酶能区分含有非经典末端的切口，并在DNA聚合酶未填补缺口中间体时将其连接。然而，在单分子水平上，LIG1和LIG3α对缺口与切口底物DNA结合动力学的差异仍不清楚。本研究利用全内反射荧光（TIRF）和连接实验，我们显示，对于含有经典A:T、错配G:T和损伤8oxoG:A的切口，LIG3α结合频率较低，但形成的复合物比LIG1更持久，并且它们在区分异常末端时表现出细微差异。此外，我们的结果将缺口DNA确定为LIG1和LIG3α能高效结合的新靶标，其效率与其优先的切口位点相当。我们展示了缺口连接，并观察到更高比例的LIG1分子在含有一个核苷酸缺口的DNA上形成稳定的长寿命复合物，而LIG3α形成短寿命的缺口复合物，且形成缺口结合复合物的分子比例无差异。最后，我们的发现表明，LIG1仍能稳定结合更大的缺口，并具有更好的识别能力，而LIG3α的结合则变得更加稀少且寿命更短。总体而言，我们的研究提供了单分子层面的见解，揭示了LIG1和LIG3α在结合一系列致突变和有害的DNA修复及复制中间体时的复杂差异，这些中间体可能在最后步骤对维持基因组稳定性构成威胁。
